ingameEffects.label: Ringing Melody (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: When a Basic Attack hits an enemy, gain 1 stack of Tea-riffic. Each stack of Tea-riffic increases the user's Impact by a percentage, stacking up to 30 times, and lasting for 8s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Upon acquiring Tea-riffic, if the equipper possesses stacks of Tea-riffic greater than or equal to 15, all squad members' DMG is increased for 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Increases the equipper's Impact for 8s, stacking up to 30 times.
